notes: Stage 3 blastocyst calibration: same minimal model run as early_development_baseline, interpreted specifically against Hardy 1989 (S-6) whole-blastocyst nuclear counts at day 5/6/7 (120/144/168h). The reference counts are observations with scatter, not hard targets; the comparison reports mean/sd, absolute/relative error and within-range verdict per point. TE/ICM allocation is NOT compared because the model has no lineage/TE-ICM concept.
